name: Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University
description: Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University (APU) is a private university in Beppu, Oita, opened in 2000 by the Ritsumeikan Trust. About half of its students are international, and most courses are offered in both English and Japanese.
whyIncluded: Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University is among the 10 universities in Japan most chosen by international students (2,927 international students in May 2025, per JASSO), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

programmes.name: College of International Management (APM), English-basis
programmes.summary: Before scholarships, 2027 entrants pay ¥1,455,000 in year 1 and ¥1,655,000 a year in years 2 to 4 (¥6,420,000 over 4 years), plus a one-off ¥200,000 admission fee. Most students get a 30-100% tuition reduction. Taught in English.
programmes.notes: Areas of study: Strategic Management and Leadership; Marketing; Accounting and Finance; Entrepreneurship and Operations Management (AACSB and AMBA accredited). 2027-entry undergraduate tuition (APU Tuition & Fees page, 0% Tuition Reduction Scholarship): year 1 ¥1,455,000 (2 semesters x ¥727,500), years 2-4 ¥1,655,000 per year, so 4-year total ¥6,420,000; recorded as the 4-year average ¥1,605,000/yr. Admission fee ¥200,000 (one-off). Tuition is semester-based: Tuition A fixed plus Tuition B that varies by semester enrolled. Comprehensive insurance (¥12,740 for first-year entrants) and AP House housing fees excluded. Most students receive a 30-100% Tuition Reduction Scholarship; the full rate is used here. No 2026-entry fee table found, so no history. laterYears added 2026-10-08 from the figures above; annualTuition is now the year-1 figure.

programmes.name: Graduate School of Management, MBA
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for 2027 entrants before scholarships, from the ¥4,200,000 programme total over 2 years. The one-off ¥200,000 is the admission fee. Taught in English.
programmes.notes: Graduate Tuition and Fees page (from AY2027): MBA total tuition ¥4,200,000 for completion, divided by a 2-year standard duration = ¥2,100,000/yr. Admission fee ¥200,000. Insurance ¥6,850 excluded. Tuition may change and varies with the APU Tuition Reduction Scholarship. Fully English-based.

programmes.name: Graduate School of Asia Pacific Studies, Master's in Asia Pacific Studies
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for 2027 entrants before scholarships, from the ¥3,110,000 programme total over 2 years. The one-off ¥200,000 is the admission fee. Taught in English.
programmes.notes: Graduate Tuition and Fees page (from AY2027): Master's in Asia Pacific Studies total tuition ¥3,110,000 for completion, divided by a 2-year standard duration = ¥1,555,000/yr. Admission fee ¥200,000. Insurance ¥6,850 excluded. Fields include International Relations, Society and Culture, Development Economics, International Public Administration, Sustainability Science, Tourism and Hospitality. Fully English-based.
